reader_summary.headline: Business Breakdowns is a series of conversations with investors and operators diving deep into a single business.
reader_summary.overview: Business Breakdowns is a series of conversations with investors and operators diving deep into a single business. For each business, we explore its history, its business model, its competitive advantages, and what makes it tick. We believe every business has lessons and secrets that investors and operators can learn from.

thesis: The episode argues that Monday.com is a high-quality enterprise software business executing well, with characteristics that should command a premium multiple of 10-11x revenue. The speaker projects significant growth, including revenue expanding north of 20% annually and free cash flow margins moving into the mid-30s, driven by a transition from small customers to solving enterprise problems similar to Salesforce or ServiceNow.

claims.quote: Monday trades at a discount to those highest quality enterprise software businesses but we think over time that will start to close.

claims.claim: The speaker projects Monday.com can grow revenue north of 20% over the next five years.
claims.quote: And we think that in five years, Monday can still be growing north of 20%.
